title: Exodus 39:6 — onyx stones engraved with the names of the sons of Israel
summary: Exodus 39:6 in English and Hebrew, with 'onyx' and the Hebrew השהם highlighted in maroon. A photo of polished red-banded onyx stones with the caption 'Onyx' sits at lower left. The verse says the onyx stones were set in gold filigree and engraved like a signet with the names of the sons of Israel.

text.text: 6 They made the onyx stones, set in gold filigree settings; they were engraved like the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the sons of Israel.
6 ויעשו את־אבני השהם מסבת משבצת זהב מפתחת פתוחי חותם על־שמות בני ישראל׃

pictures.description: Two rows of polished oval stones in glossy red-brown with white and cream wavy bands on a white background, captioned 'Onyx'.

keywords: names of the sons of Israel
